Your order doesn't change. Shop···· ships November 30, and we'll email you the tracking link the moment your miner leaves. You don't need to watch the page for it.

You're right, and I'm sorry. I can't see any update we sent you about this order, and you shouldn't have had to come looking.

Here's where it stands. The factory expects the 40Ts to ship out on November 12. They come to our warehouse first, and your miner ships to you November 30.

From here on, updates and your tracking link go to (email hidden) It's worth checking spam and adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so those emails reach your inbox.
